# ANGSUMI — bioinformatics and scientific data analysis

> ANGSUMI provides scoped, reproducible bioinformatics and scientific data analysis for research labs, PIs and PhD scholars: RNA-seq, metagenomics and microbiome analysis, research automation in Python, and publication figures. Every project starts with a feasibility review and a written scope. Run by Angsuman Das.

## Services
- [RNA-seq analysis services](https://angsumi.online/services/rna-seq-analysis/): We review feasibility and scope analysis around your biological question, study design and available reference. A count matrix alone cannot replace experimental context.
- [Metagenomics analysis services](https://angsumi.online/services/metagenomics-analysis/): Amplicon profiling and shotgun metagenomics answer different questions. We first review assay type, controls, metadata and reference coverage.
- [Bioinformatics consulting](https://angsumi.online/services/bioinformatics-consulting/): Bring your research question, available data types and the decisions you need to make. We can scope a focused review or a complete computational workflow.
- [Scientific data analysis](https://angsumi.online/services/scientific-data-analysis/): We review requests to clean, explore and model data in Python or R, with clear assumptions and reproducible outputs.
- [Scientific figure preparation](https://angsumi.online/services/scientific-figure-preparation/): We turn documented analysis outputs into readable scientific figures. Figure preparation does not change or manufacture the underlying evidence.
- [Python for research automation](https://angsumi.online/services/python-research-automation/): We scope scripts around a documented input/output contract, so recurring data work can be repeated and checked.

## Research projects
- [Bioinformatics & multi-omics learning hub](https://angsumi.online/bioinformatics/): interactive guides and workflows for genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and microbiome data.
- [RNA-seq transcriptomic analysis dashboard](https://angsumi.online/MD_RNAseq/): example transcriptome analysis project.
- [De novo transcriptome analysis](https://angsumi.online/Shruti_RNAseq_DeNovo/): example de novo RNA-seq project.
- [Environmental metabarcoding](https://angsumi.online/Sahil_Metagenome/): example environmental metabarcoding project.
